q: How many homes had a dehumidifier?
What percentage of homes with windows rarely opened had mould?
Compare the percentage of homes with mould for "windows opened daily" and "extractor fan".
Windows: 5 / 16 = about 31%. Fan: 1 / 8 = about 13%. Extractor fans were linked with less mould.
A company says "dehumidifiers stop all mould". Evaluate this using the data.

No dehumidifier homes had mould (0 / 4), which supports it, but the sample is very small (4 homes); other factors (size, sunlight, cleaning, family size) were not controlled; so the data cannot prove "all mould" is stopped.
